title: All 11 system roles appear in the list with a system badge
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the Roles & Permissions list.
custom_steps:
1. Look at the role name column for the system roles.
  2. Look at the type column for each row.
custom_expected:
All 11 system roles are listed: Administrator, Service Manager, Senior Service Advisor, Service Advisor, Foreman, Technician, Parts Manager, Parts Technician, Office User, Sales Representative, Time Clock User.

Each is marked as a system role.

There is no Owner role (it is merged into Administrator).
evidence: UI: list shows all 11 system roles (Admin, Parts Manager, Service Manager, Office User, Senior Service Advisor, Foreman, Service Advisor, Technician, Parts Technician, Time Clock User, Sales Representative) each with Role Type = System.
